summary: A Quote subscription: of a frame holding an ohlcv packet, a packet of no known size and an ohlcv cut short, only the whole one becomes a frame; a frame whose count says more packets than it carries gives the ones it has.

notes: split_message (rupeezy_websocket.py:131-145) cuts packets by their length prefix and stops when the frame ends; parse_packet (:58-121) returns None for a size that is no layout's.
